title: Steve Darnell from WelderUp & Vegas Rat Rods
description:
Steve Darnell, WelderUp owner & Vegas Rat Rods star talks about the chaos of reality TV life, and burnout that goes with it... and if he'll do a burnout in the 4BT Tahoe for us. More to come on that. Also more from Motorama 2017 coming Sunday!
